intro-1-2.text: Dustline below. Its fields went grey first. Now the Furnace burns off what's left of them.

intro-4-1.text: Twinsea. One sea burns amber, the other runs violet. The Twin wears both of them, one half each. Hit each half with the other light.

after-2-2.text: Then we keep it behind us. Those threads run on to the Foundry.
